summary: Completed comprehensive testing of new SiteNav navigation system and ThoughtsRoom accordion features. All backend APIs (43/43) passing. Frontend features fully functional: desktop vertical nav rail with progress line, multi-signal active indicators, color auto-adaptation, keyboard navigation, mobile drawer, accordion with video embed support, category filters, and pagination. ArticleReader page with share/related articles working correctly. Zero critical issues found.
passed_tests: Backend: All 43 API tests passed (100% success rate) - auth, media, pages, sections, career entries, testimonials with verified gate, projects, services, thoughts, impact items, navigation, global settings, inquiries, public page endpoint
Desktop SiteNav: Vertical chapter index with 13 CMS-derived nav items, progress line updates on scroll (0% to 100%)
Active state multi-signal indicators: marker scale transformation (1.7x), ringed marker dot, horizontal position shift, bold font-weight, animated underline
Color auto-adaptation: Nav colors change from white/light to gray/dark based on room theme (data-theme-dark attribute)
Keyboard navigation: ArrowDown/ArrowUp moves focus between nav items, Home/End jump to first/last, Enter/Space navigates and updates URL hash
Anchor support: URL hash navigation on page load scrolls to correct section (tested with #section-id)
Persistent quick-actions capsule: View Work, Connect on LinkedIn, Schedule a Conversation buttons present (Resume button correctly hidden when resume_pdf_url is empty)
Mobile navigation: Hamburger trigger opens right-side drawer with 13 nav items (48px tap targets), visible close button, Quick Actions section, Escape key closes drawer
ThoughtsRoom: Featured article showcase, accordion list with 3 items, category filter pills (All, Leadership, Delivery, Product), accordion expansion with fluid animation
Video embed support: YouTube video URL correctly renders as iframe in accordion content (tested with https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ)
Category filters: Clicking category activates filter, updates accordion list, shows 'No notes in this category yet' when empty
Pagination: Controls appear when >5 thoughts (tested with 7 total), Previous/Next buttons work, page 1/2 navigation, Previous button disabled on page 1, category filter resets pagination to page 1
ArticleReader page: Title, body content, share block (LinkedIn, Twitter, Copy Link), related articles section (3 links), back navigation, browser back button works

Regression check: All 13 rooms render correctly (Home, Introduction, Values, Founder Story, Résumé, Services, Projects, Testimonials, Thoughts, In the Field, Beyond the Work, Field Notes, Contact), zero console errors
